records.key: Exclude objects touching the box border
records.source: Exclude objects touching the box border
records.translation: 상자 테두리에 닿는 객체 제외

records.key: Magnifier added {n} object(s) — Ctrl+Z to undo
records.source: Magnifier added {n} object(s) — Ctrl+Z to undo
records.translation: 돋보기가 객체 {n}개를 추가했습니다 — Ctrl+Z 로 실행 취소

records.key: Magnifier could not segment the whole image: {error}
records.source: Magnifier could not segment the whole image: {error}
records.translation: 돋보기가 전체 이미지를 분할하지 못했습니다: {error}

records.key: Magnifier on: a click adds the object under it and a right-click removes the mask object under it; the mouse wheel changes its zoom.
records.source: Magnifier on: a click adds the object under it and a right-click removes the mask object under it; the mouse wheel changes its zoom.
records.translation: 돋보기 켜짐: 클릭하면 그 아래 객체가 추가되고 오른쪽 클릭하면 그 아래 마스크 객체가 제거되며, 마우스 휠로 확대 배율을 바꿉니다.

records.key: Magnifier removed object {label} — Ctrl+Z to undo
records.source: Magnifier removed object {label} — Ctrl+Z to undo
records.translation: 돋보기가 객체 {label}을(를) 제거했습니다 — Ctrl+Z 로 실행 취소

records.key: Magnifier: nothing was added — the Overlap rule or Min area leaves nothing of the object under the click.
records.source: Magnifier: nothing was added — the Overlap rule or Min area leaves nothing of the object under the click.
records.translation: 돋보기: 추가된 것이 없습니다 — 겹침 규칙이나 Min area 때문에 클릭한 곳의 객체가 하나도 남지 않습니다.

records.key: Magnifier: segmenting the whole image…
records.source: Magnifier: segmenting the whole image…
records.translation: 돋보기: 전체 이미지를 분할하는 중…

records.key: Magnifier: the settings changed, so the whole-image objects were discarded. Segmenting the whole image again…
records.source: Magnifier: the settings changed, so the whole-image objects were discarded. Segmenting the whole image again…
records.translation: 돋보기: 설정이 바뀌어 전체 이미지의 객체를 버렸습니다. 전체 이미지를 다시 분할하는 중…

records.key: Magnifier: the whole image is still being segmented — nothing was added.
records.source: Magnifier: the whole image is still being segmented — nothing was added.
records.translation: 돋보기: 전체 이미지를 아직 분할하는 중입니다 — 추가된 것이 없습니다.

records.key: Magnifier: there is no mask object under the click — nothing was removed.
records.source: Magnifier: there is no mask object under the click — nothing was removed.
records.translation: 돋보기: 클릭한 곳에 마스크 객체가 없습니다 — 제거된 것이 없습니다.

records.key: Magnifier: there is no object under the click — nothing was added.
records.source: Magnifier: there is no object under the click — nothing was added.
records.translation: 돋보기: 클릭한 곳에 객체가 없습니다 — 추가된 것이 없습니다.

records.key: Magnifier: whole-image segmentation cancelled. Click the image to start it again.
records.source: Magnifier: whole-image segmentation cancelled. Click the image to start it again.
records.translation: 돋보기: 전체 이미지 분할을 취소했습니다. 다시 시작하려면 이미지를 클릭하십시오.

records.key: Magnifier: {n} object(s) found in the whole image. Click one to add it; right-click an object in the mask to remove it.
records.source: Magnifier: {n} object(s) found in the whole image. Click one to add it; right-click an object in the mask to remove it.
records.translation: 돋보기: 전체 이미지에서 객체 {n}개를 찾았습니다. 추가하려면 하나를 클릭하고, 제거하려면 마스크의 객체를 오른쪽 클릭하십시오.

records.key: Region under the mouse
records.source: Region under the mouse
records.translation: 마우스 아래 영역

records.key: Segment
records.source: Segment
records.translation: 분할 대상

records.key: Segments the region under the mouse, or the whole image once, and shows its objects magnified. A click adds objects to the mask.
records.source: Segments the region under the mouse, or the whole image once, and shows its objects magnified. A click adds objects to the mask.
records.translation: 마우스 아래 영역 또는 전체 이미지를 한 번 분할하고 그 객체를 확대해 보여 줍니다. 클릭하면 마스크에 객체가 추가됩니다.

records.key: Show a box under the mouse with the region around it magnified and the objects a model finds in it outlined. A click adds them to the mask as new objects — under Whole image, only the object clicked — one undo step per click. While it is on, the mouse wheel changes the box's zoom rather than the view's.
records.source: Show a box under the mouse with the region around it magnified and the objects a model finds in it outlined. A click adds them to the mask as new objects — under Whole image, only the object clicked — one undo step per click. While it is on, the mouse wheel changes the box's zoom rather than the view's.
records.translation: 마우스 아래에 주변 영역을 확대하고 모델이 그 안에서 찾은 객체의 윤곽을 표시하는 상자를 보여 줍니다. 클릭하면 그 객체들이 새 객체로 마스크에 추가되며(전체 이미지에서는 클릭한 객체만), 클릭마다 실행 취소 한 단계가 됩니다. 켜져 있는 동안 마우스 휠은 보기 대신 상자의 확대 배율을 바꿉니다.

records.key: What the model segments. Region under the mouse runs it on the box as the mouse moves, and a click adds every object the box outlines. Whole image runs it once on the entire image in the background; the box then shows those objects, a click adds the object under it, and a right-click removes the mask object under it. Changing a setting the model reads discards the whole-image objects and segments the image again.
records.source: What the model segments. Region under the mouse runs it on the box as the mouse moves, and a click adds every object the box outlines. Whole image runs it once on the entire image in the background; the box then shows those objects, a click adds the object under it, and a right-click removes the mask object under it. Changing a setting the model reads discards the whole-image objects and segments the image again.
records.translation: 모델이 무엇을 분할할지입니다. 마우스 아래 영역은 마우스가 움직이는 동안 상자에 모델을 실행하고, 클릭하면 상자에 윤곽이 표시된 모든 객체가 추가됩니다. 전체 이미지는 백그라운드에서 전체 이미지에 모델을 한 번 실행합니다. 그러면 상자가 그 객체들을 보여 주고, 클릭하면 그 아래 객체가 추가되며, 오른쪽 클릭하면 그 아래 마스크 객체가 제거됩니다. 모델이 읽는 설정을 바꾸면 전체 이미지의 객체를 버리고 이미지를 다시 분할합니다.

records.key: When ticked, an object that touches an edge of the box inside the image is not offered, because the box may have cut it off. Untick it to offer and add such objects too, as far as the box sees them. Objects at the image border are offered either way. It applies to Region under the mouse; Whole image never cuts an object.
records.source: When ticked, an object that touches an edge of the box inside the image is not offered, because the box may have cut it off. Untick it to offer and add such objects too, as far as the box sees them. Objects at the image border are offered either way. It applies to Region under the mouse; Whole image never cuts an object.
records.translation: 선택하면 이미지 안쪽에서 상자 가장자리에 닿는 객체는 상자가 잘랐을 수 있으므로 제시되지 않습니다. 선택을 해제하면 그런 객체도 상자에 보이는 만큼 제시되고 추가됩니다. 이미지 가장자리에 있는 객체는 어느 경우든 제시됩니다. 마우스 아래 영역에 적용되며, 전체 이미지는 객체를 자르지 않습니다.

records.key: Whole image
records.source: Whole image
records.translation: 전체 이미지
